1	---
2	name: stdo-work
3	description: Execute one admitted STDO work item through its lawful re-entry point. Use when a user says stdo work or explicitly asks to perform requirements, design, code, or test work under an STDO-governed basis. Do not invoke for generic non-STDO development.
4	---
5	
6	# STDO Work
7	
8	Deliver the smallest causally closed change authorized by one exact work basis.
9	The admitted re-entry point decides where work begins.
10	
11	## Select The Product Basis
12	
13	Read and apply
14	[`PRODUCT_BASIS.md`](../../references/PRODUCT_BASIS.md) before drafting an
15	execution contract or changing any surface. Continue only from its exactly-one
16	verified selection; that selection grants no work or mutation authority.
17	
18	## Acquire The Responsibility Frame
19	
20	After the exact Product basis is selected, resolve the selected cut's
21	[standards index](../../../../standards/README.md) and the accepted Project
22	Reference-Frame Basis for the responsibility named by the task. This is read-only
23	acquisition inside an already-authorized inspection scope. Effectful work still
24	needs its separately admitted work contract; acquisition is not another admission
25	or actor stage. If a required frame basis is absent or unverified, return that
26	missing binding before dependent action. Inspection supplies no adopted role.
27	
28	For interrupted work or uncertain effects, the index's work/recovery route
29	projects current-state, applicability, authority and continuation clauses.
30	For intake triage, lawful re-entry, carrier selection or execution-contract
31	admission, use the index's triage/carrier route. For a typed construction handoff
32	or transformation admission, use its constitutional-derivation route. Resolve
33	the selected view from the verified basis; its owner sections and digests make
34	the initial acquisition reproducible from that published route.
35	For another task use its relevant route or directly acquire the deciding owners.
36	Select only available material in the verified basis: a cut without a curated
37	view still uses its exact owner clauses; a mutable candidate is no fallback.
38	
39	Acquire the bound subject and basis from the workspace, its selected snapshot
40	and authoritative inputs before relying on a retained summary. Discarded private context does not reset the workspace. The
41	selected work/recovery or triage frame carries the workspace/context contract
42	and core result algebra. Keep candidate availability, fitness and authorised
43	acceptance as separate predicates. Carry the complete core result record,
44	including its predicate, subject and basis, original outcome and reason,
45	performance, evidence, effect observations and unresolved coverage.
46	
47	Read the selected frame and the actual subject. Follow material source and
48	coupled-obligation references when the task needs them. The view alone makes no
49	universal sufficiency claim and supplies no role, effect or decision grant.
50	Do not load the corpus merely because it is present. If coupled material does
51	not fit the capable activation, retain the unknown and use an already-authorized
52	refinement, support or stop; do not silently reduce the required predicate.
53	
54	## Classify From The Available Evidence
55	
56	Apply the selected basis's `SPEC_METHOD.md` intake and agentic-construction
57	rules. Use declared source/worksite/proof tools to compute the affected owner
58	and authority-layer routes, the complete relevant Public serialized membership
59	and value delta, and accepted-design trace coverage. Bind their exact inputs,
60	producer, output and freshness. A file diff alone is not a Public comparison;
61	an existing trace is not a judgment of semantic sufficiency. Missing targets,
62	serialization or trace mappings remain explicit unknowns. Do not invent a
63	tool result or make the STDO distribution manager a worksite analyzer.
64	
65	Reuse applicable computed facts and recorded classification/materiality
66	judgments from the existing work carrier. Check the question, subject, basis,
67	support and revising observation; a different role alone does not require
68	reclassification. Judge only the residual needed to select the smallest lawful
69	path and record its basis once. An unresolved owner choice stays with its owner.
70	Use one bounded discriminator when it can resolve a material unknown.
71	
72	Distinguish a failed candidate from a changed requested outcome. If a helper
73	edit violates an unchanged Public requirement, reject or repair the candidate
74	inside the existing grant. Re-enter the requirement owner when the selected
75	outcome needs changed governing meaning. Candidate bytes cannot choose that
76	outcome or enlarge the grant.
77	
78	## Establish The Work Basis
79	
80	1. Establish applicable upstream work authority under the verified definition
81	   and immutable basis. Without it, stop before
82	   selecting a carrier; a ticket cannot substitute for that authority. Then
83	   select the first applicable source for one run-scoped execution contract:
84	
85	   - reuse an exact admitted durable ticket when it covers the work;
86	   - otherwise require one authorized durable ticket only when work or an
87	     obligation needs independent state beyond its admitted sprint or, outside
88	     a sprint, beyond the current run;
89	   - otherwise use the admitted sprint plus one manifest-local iteration entry
90	     when the work ends by sprint close; or
91	   - otherwise use an intake draft for work that ends in the current run.
92	
93	   Do not invoke `stdo-ticket` automatically. Absence of a ticket neither
94	   requires nor authorizes creating one.
95	2. Bind the contract's current Goal or exact work instruction, `change_intent`,
96	   change class, re-entry point, `target_truth`, relevant `superseded_truth`,
97	   `closure_law`, governing requirement and accepted design, checkpoint,
98	   affected relation set, write territory, evaluation criteria, non-closure
99	   conditions, proof surface, and one Product-bound durable result/evidence
100	   surface. If that result surface is unavailable or unauthorized, admission
101	   must refuse.
102	3. Validate and admit or reject that exact contract. Drafting, admission, and
103	   execution may occur in the same invocation, but ticket presence, `active`
104	   status, a generic work request, or the model's own draft cannot supply
105	   admission. Continue only after deterministic admission or an exact human
106	   override of the bounded contract. Record the Product-bound admitting
107	   mechanism and authority, exact contract identity or digest, decision, and
108	   evidence. If those coordinates are absent, return the missing authority and
109	   stop.
110	   Consume an existing exact owner instruction or admitted grant when it
111	   already covers this contract; cite it instead of requesting the same
112	   authorization again. Record the binding, not another approval round.
113	4. Re-enter at the first changed layer and flow forward:
114	
115	   - requirement change: establish the successor/current requirement as the
116	     sole operative truth; supersede or withdraw a published live domain
117	     artifact instead of mutating it in place;
118	   - design change: admit the structural decision before implementation relies
119	     on it; or
120	   - realization change: prove upstream Goals, Intent, Product, requirements,
121	     and accepted design remain unchanged.
122	5. If work discovers an obligation that needs state beyond its local carrier
123	   boundary, do not claim closure or create a ticket without authority. Persist
124	   it only when the current exact grant already includes ticket-state mutation
125	   for that obligation. Otherwise retain it in the contract's named durable
126	   result/evidence surface or an already-authorized enclosing carrier, mark
127	   closure withheld, and return the required re-entry plus an explicit
128	   `stdo-ticket` route without invoking it. A conversation return alone is not
129	   durable evidence.
130	
131	## Construct And Prove
132	
133	Use the accepted Project Reference-Frame Basis to determine applicable
134	evaluations, including those required by an affected owner. A known false
135	condition omits that evaluation; an unknown condition needs a bounded
136	resolution or explicit residual. Missing required results cannot count as
137	satisfied. Availability of a frame does not require activating it.
138	
139	When that basis permits direct Writer use and one sufficient context/grant
140	covers the outcome, construct directly without an additional Executive,
141	Reviewer or durable ticket. Activate coordination for a material dependency,
142	authority or context boundary. While occupying Executive, do not edit files or
143	Git state; the same actor must first enter a separately bound Writer activation.
144	An actual independence requirement still needs an independent capable actor.
145	One exact Writer grant may cover its declared construction, status and checkpoint
146	sequence. Record actual role transitions; unchanged status alone does not need
147	a new activation or wholesale rehash. Refresh bindings on material change.
148	
149	1. Work inside the smallest coherent causal cone and exact write territory.
150	   Read material producers, consumers and owners across that cone within the
151	   access grant; narrow write territory is not a narrower reasoning boundary.
152	   Return cross-territory repairs to their owner.
153	   Preserve solution space where variation cannot change a governed property.
154	2. Implement and self-review the bounded change.
155	3. Derive tests through:
156	
157	   ```text
158	   work carrier -> triage -> re-entry -> requirement/design/module/closure law
159	   ```
160	
161	4. Use the cheapest focused falsifier adequate for the claim. Add integration,
162	   installed-development, harnessed sandbox, or live sandbox evidence only
163	   where the Product claim requires it. A real probabilistic boundary requires
164	   a live lane.
165	5. Reconcile authority, design, implementation, tests, and displaced rival
166	   paths before claiming a candidate.
167	   Consume established facts while their exact subject, basis, scope,
168	   provenance and validity apply. Function boundaries alone do not invalidate
169	   them; mutation, rollback, authority/basis change and actual trust boundaries
170	   retain their applicable checks. For material computational composition or
171	   recurrence, inspect the complete path and its accumulated work under the
172	   owning design and optional frame refinement. Qualify declared workloads and
173	   operational assumptions rather than inferring adequacy from local green.
174	   Retire superseded responsibility; retained mechanisms need a supported
175	   obligation, owner, purpose, scope and cost, and temporary ones a removal
176	   trigger. Audit affected test predicates against the supported operating and
177	   threat model; an excluded threat cannot require a replacement guard.
178	6. Return the exact candidate and stop at a delegated return boundary.
179	   Product-owned decision authority, or an
180	   authorized Executive when that profile is adopted, decides whether Product,
181	   qualification, release, risk, or admitted-work law requires independence
182	   and separately activates `stdo-review`.
183	
184	Keep reusable judgments and owner rulings in the existing carrier: exact
185	question, subject/basis, supporting computed evidence, actor and authority,
186	conclusion, scope, uncertainty and revising observation. Preserve the original
187	owner ruling separately from interpretation. Invalidate the affected claim
188	when its support changes; retain unrelated valid results. Reuse does not
189	manufacture an owner ruling or satisfy required independent assessment.
190	
191	On repricing, retain, supersede, defer or withdraw each affected obligation with
192	its owner/evidence links in this carrier. Present the short consequence delta;
193	"continue" does not accept an undisclosed architectural change. An authorized
194	preservation checkpoint can keep unfinished work with its predecessor,
195	territory, concurrent-writer disposition and durable evidence; it claims no
196	acceptance or publication.
197	
198	Evaluate closure as the conjunction of satisfied applicable obligations,
199	valid supporting evidence, required judgments/rulings and absence of an active
200	non-closure condition. A review event is not completion. Record a satisfied
201	bounded result under the existing state-mutation grant; withhold only the
202	affected claim when a condition is missing. Qualification, publication and
203	consumer adoption retain their separate conditions.
204	
205	## Return
206	
207	Return the exact candidate/checkpoint, changed paths, affected authority,
208	execution-contract admission mechanism/result/evidence, focused and broader
209	proof, non-changes, residuals, and closed or withheld work result. Do not
210	claim acceptance beyond the grant, discard a surviving obligation, or silently
211	continue beyond a delegated return boundary.

# STDO Work

Deliver the smallest causally closed change authorized by one exact work basis.
The admitted re-entry point decides where work begins.

## Select The Product Basis

Read and apply
[`PRODUCT_BASIS.md`](../../references/PRODUCT_BASIS.md) before drafting an
execution contract or changing any surface. Continue only from its exactly-one
verified selection; that selection grants no work or mutation authority.

## Acquire The Responsibility Frame

After the exact Product basis is selected, resolve the selected cut's
[standards index](../../../../standards/README.md) and the accepted Project
Reference-Frame Basis for the responsibility named by the task. This is read-only
acquisition inside an already-authorized inspection scope. Effectful work still
needs its separately admitted work contract; acquisition is not another admission
or actor stage. If a required frame basis is absent or unverified, return that
missing binding before dependent action. Inspection supplies no adopted role.

For interrupted work or uncertain effects, the index's work/recovery route
projects current-state, applicability, authority and continuation clauses.
For intake triage, lawful re-entry, carrier selection or execution-contract
admission, use the index's triage/carrier route. For a typed construction handoff
or transformation admission, use its constitutional-derivation route. Resolve
the selected view from the verified basis; its owner sections and digests make
the initial acquisition reproducible from that published route.
For another task use its relevant route or directly acquire the deciding owners.
Select only available material in the verified basis: a cut without a curated
view still uses its exact owner clauses; a mutable candidate is no fallback.

Acquire the bound subject and basis from the workspace, its selected snapshot
and authoritative inputs before relying on a retained summary. Discarded private context does not reset the workspace. The
selected work/recovery or triage frame carries the workspace/context contract
and core result algebra. Keep candidate availability, fitness and authorised
acceptance as separate predicates. Carry the complete core result record,
including its predicate, subject and basis, original outcome and reason,
performance, evidence, effect observations and unresolved coverage.

Read the selected frame and the actual subject. Follow material source and
coupled-obligation references when the task needs them. The view alone makes no
universal sufficiency claim and supplies no role, effect or decision grant.
Do not load the corpus merely because it is present. If coupled material does
not fit the capable activation, retain the unknown and use an already-authorized
refinement, support or stop; do not silently reduce the required predicate.

## Classify From The Available Evidence

Apply the selected basis's `SPEC_METHOD.md` intake and agentic-construction
rules. Use declared source/worksite/proof tools to compute the affected owner
and authority-layer routes, the complete relevant Public serialized membership
and value delta, and accepted-design trace coverage. Bind their exact inputs,
producer, output and freshness. A file diff alone is not a Public comparison;
an existing trace is not a judgment of semantic sufficiency. Missing targets,
serialization or trace mappings remain explicit unknowns. Do not invent a
tool result or make the STDO distribution manager a worksite analyzer.

Reuse applicable computed facts and recorded classification/materiality
judgments from the existing work carrier. Check the question, subject, basis,
support and revising observation; a different role alone does not require
reclassification. Judge only the residual needed to select the smallest lawful
path and record its basis once. An unresolved owner choice stays with its owner.
Use one bounded discriminator when it can resolve a material unknown.

Distinguish a failed candidate from a changed requested outcome. If a helper
edit violates an unchanged Public requirement, reject or repair the candidate
inside the existing grant. Re-enter the requirement owner when the selected
outcome needs changed governing meaning. Candidate bytes cannot choose that
outcome or enlarge the grant.

## Establish The Work Basis

1. Establish applicable upstream work authority under the verified definition
   and immutable basis. Without it, stop before
   selecting a carrier; a ticket cannot substitute for that authority. Then
   select the first applicable source for one run-scoped execution contract:

   - reuse an exact admitted durable ticket when it covers the work;
   - otherwise require one authorized durable ticket only when work or an
     obligation needs independent state beyond its admitted sprint or, outside
     a sprint, beyond the current run;
   - otherwise use the admitted sprint plus one manifest-local iteration entry
     when the work ends by sprint close; or
   - otherwise use an intake draft for work that ends in the current run.

   Do not invoke `stdo-ticket` automatically. Absence of a ticket neither
   requires nor authorizes creating one.
2. Bind the contract's current Goal or exact work instruction, `change_intent`,
   change class, re-entry point, `target_truth`, relevant `superseded_truth`,
   `closure_law`, governing requirement and accepted design, checkpoint,
   affected relation set, write territory, evaluation criteria, non-closure
   conditions, proof surface, and one Product-bound durable result/evidence
   surface. If that result surface is unavailable or unauthorized, admission
   must refuse.
3. Validate and admit or reject that exact contract. Drafting, admission, and
   execution may occur in the same invocation, but ticket presence, `active`
   status, a generic work request, or the model's own draft cannot supply
   admission. Continue only after deterministic admission or an exact human
   override of the bounded contract. Record the Product-bound admitting
   mechanism and authority, exact contract identity or digest, decision, and
   evidence. If those coordinates are absent, return the missing authority and
   stop.
   Consume an existing exact owner instruction or admitted grant when it
   already covers this contract; cite it instead of requesting the same
   authorization again. Record the binding, not another approval round.
4. Re-enter at the first changed layer and flow forward:

   - requirement change: establish the successor/current requirement as the
     sole operative truth; supersede or withdraw a published live domain
     artifact instead of mutating it in place;
   - design change: admit the structural decision before implementation relies
     on it; or
   - realization change: prove upstream Goals, Intent, Product, requirements,
     and accepted design remain unchanged.
5. If work discovers an obligation that needs state beyond its local carrier
   boundary, do not claim closure or create a ticket without authority. Persist
   it only when the current exact grant already includes ticket-state mutation
   for that obligation. Otherwise retain it in the contract's named durable
   result/evidence surface or an already-authorized enclosing carrier, mark
   closure withheld, and return the required re-entry plus an explicit
   `stdo-ticket` route without invoking it. A conversation return alone is not
   durable evidence.

## Construct And Prove

Use the accepted Project Reference-Frame Basis to determine applicable
evaluations, including those required by an affected owner. A known false
condition omits that evaluation; an unknown condition needs a bounded
resolution or explicit residual. Missing required results cannot count as
satisfied. Availability of a frame does not require activating it.

When that basis permits direct Writer use and one sufficient context/grant
covers the outcome, construct directly without an additional Executive,
Reviewer or durable ticket. Activate coordination for a material dependency,
authority or context boundary. While occupying Executive, do not edit files or
Git state; the same actor must first enter a separately bound Writer activation.
An actual independence requirement still needs an independent capable actor.
One exact Writer grant may cover its declared construction, status and checkpoint
sequence. Record actual role transitions; unchanged status alone does not need
a new activation or wholesale rehash. Refresh bindings on material change.

1. Work inside the smallest coherent causal cone and exact write territory.
   Read material producers, consumers and owners across that cone within the
   access grant; narrow write territory is not a narrower reasoning boundary.
   Return cross-territory repairs to their owner.
   Preserve solution space where variation cannot change a governed property.
2. Implement and self-review the bounded change.
3. Derive tests through:

   ```text
   work carrier -> triage -> re-entry -> requirement/design/module/closure law
   ```

4. Use the cheapest focused falsifier adequate for the claim. Add integration,
   installed-development, harnessed sandbox, or live sandbox evidence only
   where the Product claim requires it. A real probabilistic boundary requires
   a live lane.
5. Reconcile authority, design, implementation, tests, and displaced rival
   paths before claiming a candidate.
   Consume established facts while their exact subject, basis, scope,
   provenance and validity apply. Function boundaries alone do not invalidate
   them; mutation, rollback, authority/basis change and actual trust boundaries
   retain their applicable checks. For material computational composition or
   recurrence, inspect the complete path and its accumulated work under the
   owning design and optional frame refinement. Qualify declared workloads and
   operational assumptions rather than inferring adequacy from local green.
   Retire superseded responsibility; retained mechanisms need a supported
   obligation, owner, purpose, scope and cost, and temporary ones a removal
   trigger. Audit affected test predicates against the supported operating and
   threat model; an excluded threat cannot require a replacement guard.
6. Return the exact candidate and stop at a delegated return boundary.
   Product-owned decision authority, or an
   authorized Executive when that profile is adopted, decides whether Product,
   qualification, release, risk, or admitted-work law requires independence
   and separately activates `stdo-review`.

Keep reusable judgments and owner rulings in the existing carrier: exact
question, subject/basis, supporting computed evidence, actor and authority,
conclusion, scope, uncertainty and revising observation. Preserve the original
owner ruling separately from interpretation. Invalidate the affected claim
when its support changes; retain unrelated valid results. Reuse does not
manufacture an owner ruling or satisfy required independent assessment.

On repricing, retain, supersede, defer or withdraw each affected obligation with
its owner/evidence links in this carrier. Present the short consequence delta;
"continue" does not accept an undisclosed architectural change. An authorized
preservation checkpoint can keep unfinished work with its predecessor,
territory, concurrent-writer disposition and durable evidence; it claims no
acceptance or publication.

Evaluate closure as the conjunction of satisfied applicable obligations,
valid supporting evidence, required judgments/rulings and absence of an active
non-closure condition. A review event is not completion. Record a satisfied
bounded result under the existing state-mutation grant; withhold only the
affected claim when a condition is missing. Qualification, publication and
consumer adoption retain their separate conditions.

## Return

Return the exact candidate/checkpoint, changed paths, affected authority,
execution-contract admission mechanism/result/evidence, focused and broader
proof, non-changes, residuals, and closed or withheld work result. Do not
claim acceptance beyond the grant, discard a surviving obligation, or silently
continue beyond a delegated return boundary.

### Checkpoint, Continuation, Progress, And Churn

Acceptance binds one exact checkpoint. The next already-authorized bounded
action may begin without renewed human approval; acceptance does not widen the
Product outcome or affected relation set.

A preservation checkpoint may retain unfinished or unaccepted work under an
existing exact operation grant. Identify its parent or predecessor, included
territory, concurrent-writer disposition and durable evidence location. It is
neither acceptance, promotion nor publication. A proposed restart identifies
why repair of retained work is insufficient, which obligations and evidence
survive, and which causal assumptions change; reconstructability alone does
not select reconstruction.

Accepted material Product movement is progress. Prerequisite work names the
Product obligation it enables. Preservation and repeated proof are evidence,
not new progress. Rejected or superseded construction is churn. Discovery of
previously hidden distance revises the forecast but is not itself negative
implementation progress. Paperwork, code volume, test count, commit count, and
review count are not Product progress by themselves.

These are semantic categories, not a numeric progress algorithm. Consumers may
derive their own progress and churn projections from them.

This protocol is false if execution proceeds from unreconstructable context,
if a constructor's report substitutes for required independent live evidence,
if a bounded proxy changes a governing relation outside its delegation, if
unrelated incompleteness blocks a closed causal cone, if a same-process test is
used to prove materially cross-process authority, or if rejected activity is
reported as accepted Product progress.

---

## Complete Enclosing-Relation Admission (`STDO-UP-021`)

For a material transition, each admission owner is independently responsible
for deriving and validating the complete enclosing relation from authoritative
inputs. The relation contains every participant and equality join whose
identity, validity, authority, currentness, or transition can affect or be
affected by admission; each crossing seam includes its relevant far side or
authoritatively establishes
that the far side cannot participate. Caller or owner assertions of
completeness, validity, prior admission, or authority do not establish truth.

An owner may consume established facts when their exact subject, basis, scope,
provenance and validity remain applicable to its relation. Their production and
invalidation must be recoverable; an unsupported assertion of prior success is
not such a fact. A function, component, role, conversation or status boundary
alone invalidates none of those coordinates and requires no repeated derivation.
Material mutation, rollback, changed authority or basis, expired validity, and
an actual trust boundary trigger the applicable validation before reliance or
effect. Reuse does not transfer the owner's admission responsibility, omit a
participant or satisfy a separately required independent judgment.

Derivation and validation bind one exact admission-valid authoritative basis
identity through admission. If validity or currentness can advance after
preflight, admission remains conditional on the declared predecessor and
currentness law for that basis or re-enters derivation and validation without
effect. Participating owners bind an equal basis or a design-declared coherent
composite basis; independently valid mixed-basis judgments cannot combine.
